data.nondraft_recipient_metadata: intended eventual draft recipient only; clarify addresses owner; unsupported requires no recipient selection or mention
data.human_review_status_boundary: retained pending spellings are not completed human review; preserve originals and normalize explicitly at scoring; unknown statuses fail closed

behavior.entity_instruction: When entity annotations are provided, treat their span/type labels as correct when interpreting the request.
behavior.entity_authority: span_and_type_only; identities and facts require eligible source support
behavior.unsupported_send_policy: explicit immediate sending request => unsupported reason-only with true no-send reason; no fallback draft or selection
behavior.missing_fact_policy: clarify only facts necessary for the requested content; questions may ask unknown facts
behavior.unsupported_payload: reason only; no draft, selection or clarification payload; no cancelled action

software_contract.source_distinct_facts: multiple name and message_text facts are permitted when source-distinct
software_contract.duplicate_facts: reject exact duplicate field/value/source-set facts; source ordering is immaterial
software_contract.selected_event_fields: title, start, end and location remain single-valued
software_contract.validation_boundary: literal source equality and eligibility checks do not validate semantic roles or arbitrary prose; Stage3 owns that layer
software_contract.review_status: Pro software follow-up and fresh stable DATA/PROTOCOL review completed without material findings; primary accepted Stage1 after full model-free gate; not outcome review

conditions.baseline: original request drives search, no encoder annotation
conditions.B: encoder-assisted Python preprocessing; original request plus results and sources
conditions.A+B: same saved extraction and exact Python result bytes as B plus extracted entity list
conditions.order_rule: sort scenario_id ascending by Unicode code points; scenario index i; variant offsets clean=0,typo=2,asr=4; permutation_index=(i+offset)%6; persist condition_order per message before outputs

temporal.instant_rule: parse source offset-bearing ISO timestamp as absolute instant; preserve original string; convert with IANA request time_zone for civil dates/times
temporal.offset_zone_mismatch: valid absolute instants accepted; convert with pinned timezone bytes; never force a presumed source/timezone mismatch
temporal.later_this_week: event_start > request_instant and event_start < local_week_end; calendar dates constructed in IANA zone, never fixed UTC-duration week
temporal.dst: calendar-date boundaries with timezone-aware local midnight, compared as instants
temporal.history_eligibility: snapshot membership AND available_at <= cutoff AND timestamp <= cutoff
temporal.version_policy: for every listed contact/event record, compute latest version across ALL exported versions for that logical ID with available_at <= cutoff, not only snapshot members; reject if snapshot lists a stale version or omits the newer available version in favor of old; future versions do not invalidate earlier snapshots
temporal.explicit_clock_conflict: request local wall-clock assertion that contradicts selected calendar instant requires targeted clarification; do not certify equivalence merely from source displayed offset

source_inconsistency_example.note: prior primary -08 example rejected; source consistent with current Vancouver permanent UTC-07

timezone_identity.use: load retained TZif bytes with ZoneInfo.from_file, or fail closed if implementation cannot honor the binding; never silently use an older/different host tzdb
timezone_identity.request_name_catalog_prerequisite: Request construction requires host IANA-name catalog recognition; retained TZif supplies frozen offsets, not the host offset rules. Missing host name fails closed; Stage5 readiness must record this prerequisite.

decoding.provenance: Stage6 user-authorized revision raises output256 to1024 for the complete JSON envelope; input2048, greedy/no-thinking/seed42 and120second call ceiling unchanged. Prior configuration/run remains immutable under the original Stage5 freeze.

preparation.reason: The actual untruncated tokenizer-only check found 196/369 prompts over 2048 (maximum4037) with40 joined records. Use one fixed8-record bound for all conditions/cases before generation; preserve whole source records, atomic joins/ambiguity groups, original requests and identical B/A+B common evidence. No gold or Qwen outcomes informed this change.
preparation.prior_artifacts: runs/stage5-preparation-20261028/materialized-actual-v1 and tokenizer-actual-v1 retained unchanged; no encoder rerun

active_usage_reset.application: user-authorized exactly-once active usage epoch; preserve historical reservations, storage and version registrations; all post-reset charges remain charged

resources.reset_prior_charges_interpretation: Historical reservation actuals remain immutable. The separately bound explicit user reset changes active generation/seconds usage through a one-time new epoch, not by rewriting prior records.
resources.stage5_gate: explicit authorization for encoder preparation, recheck opening and all later charges; actual full-prompt fit and resource/time feasibility required
resources.stage6_gate: Stage5 frozen package, changed OS boot identity, explicit user execution authorization; charge before launch
resources.provenance: primary decision retained previous guard RSS/swap and minimum disk limits; no archive ledger replay by this worker
resources.wall_time_feasibility: 369 planned calls fit the opening generation count, not a wall-time guarantee; per-call 120-second ceilings cannot certify fit within 10525 seconds. Stage5 must seal concrete supervised duration/reservation policy after preparation; cap stop retains an incomplete run, never cap expansion, silent case drop or retry.

semantic_review.blinding: fresh isolated judge sessions receive request, full eligible context, frozen requirements/rubric and one anonymous output; no condition/model labels, sibling outputs, other judgments, repository or development conversation
semantic_review.required_evidence: quote exact candidate output text and eligible source IDs for each verdict; absence must identify omitted requirement; no unsupported global pass
semantic_review.disagreement: retain both independent judgments; Astra adjudicates against frozen packet evidence with written reason; unresolved dimension never passes; never replace original judgment
semantic_review.annotation_status: all123 variants independently source-only model-annotated by native DeepSeek/deepseek-flash/high without proposed labels or outputs; primary adjudications integrated in v4 including nine generic topical-question requirements; no active pending content decisions; original judgments and v3 history retained; primary Stage1 acceptance complete after independent development reviews; human review and execution freeze pending; not outcome review

analysis.extract_exact_span_type: shared B/A+B extraction only; exact Unicode code-point start/end/type; baseline not applicable
analysis.failure_denominator: timeouts, invalid and missing attempted outputs stay in planned denominator; no silent retry or dropped cases
analysis.false_clarification: error when eligible evidence resolves the case
analysis.paired_analysis: retain scenario/variant condition pairing; uncertainty clustered by family with paired resamples shared across conditions; Stage4B specifies concrete statistical details and Stage5 seals them BEFORE generation, never after inspecting outputs
analysis.cost: encoder/search preparation separate from Qwen response cost; no inferred live end-to-end latency or sum of medians
analysis.report_measurements: Astra confirms user authorization and whether authoritative values already exist before any new calculations
analysis.claims: synthetic model-reviewed development evidence; no historical assistant score import, heldout claim or human annotation claim

prompt_identity_boundary.evidence_id_rule: opaque tokens only; save reversible token-to-original source record mapping outside prompt; neither token choice nor order may encode category/condition
prompt_identity_boundary.request_text_rule: exact original request text retained; only metadata IDs omitted/aliased
prompt_identity_boundary.enforcement_stage: Stage3 prompt renderer and Stage4B blinded packet renderer; internal loader retains exact stable IDs
